narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation OUT of mega-cap tech (MSFT, AAPL, ORCL, TSLA) and INTO healthcare (ABBV, MRK, JNJ, LLY), financials (MA, AXP, GS, BAC), and staples (KO, PEP, PM). Within semis, smart money is selectively long AMAT/AVGO while distributing KLAC — a quality/leverage screen rather than a sector call.

COST and XOM bearish diverge from typical staples/energy defensive bids. AMAT/AVGO bullish vs KLAC bearish is an intra-semi divergence worth flagging against any blanket semiconductor industry signal.
